name: STEPS Basics
description: Common STEPS (.building/.step) code templates and patterns

snippets.name: Comment
snippets.description: Single-line comment
snippets.content: note: This is a comment

snippets.name: Block Comment
snippets.description: Multi-line comment block
snippets.content:
note block:
    This comment spans
    multiple lines.
end note

snippets.name: Variable Assignment
snippets.description: Create/assign a variable
snippets.content:
set age to 25
set first_name to "Alice"

snippets.name: Typed Declaration
snippets.description: Declare a typed variable inside a step or riser
snippets.content:
declare:
    count as number
    message as text
    score as number fixed

snippets.name: Type Conversion
snippets.description: Convert a value to another type with as
snippets.content:
set num to text_num as number
display pi as decimal(2)

snippets.name: Display
snippets.description: Print a value with a trailing newline
snippets.content: display "Hello, World!"

snippets.name: Indicate
snippets.description: Print without a trailing newline (progress bars, prompts)
snippets.content: indicate "Loading..."

snippets.name: Input
snippets.description: Read raw or typed input from the user
snippets.content:
set name to input
set age to input as number

snippets.name: If/Otherwise If/Otherwise
snippets.description: Conditional chain using worded comparisons
snippets.content:
if age is less than 13
    display "You are a child."
otherwise if age is less than 20
    display "You are a teenager."
otherwise
    display "You are an adult."

snippets.name: Repeat N Times
snippets.description: Fixed-count loop
snippets.content:
repeat 5 times
    display (counter as text)
    set counter to counter + 1

snippets.name: Repeat While
snippets.description: Condition-based loop
snippets.content:
repeat while countdown is greater than 0
    display (countdown as text)
    set countdown to countdown - 1

snippets.name: Repeat For Each
snippets.description: Iterate over a list
snippets.content:
repeat for each fruit in fruits
    display "- " added to fruit

snippets.name: Step (Function)
snippets.description: Define a step with inputs, a return value, and a body
snippets.content:
step: calculate_tax
    belongs to: calculations
    expects: amount, rate
    returns: tax

    do:
        set tax to amount * (rate / 100)
        return tax

snippets.name: Riser (Private Helper)
snippets.description: A private helper function nested inside a step
snippets.content:
riser: calculate_percentage
    expects: value, pct
    returns: result

    do:
        set result to value * (pct / 100)
        return result

snippets.name: Call a Step
snippets.description: Call a step and store its result
snippets.content: call calculate_tax with amount, rate storing result in tax

snippets.name: Building (Program)
snippets.description: Top-level program entry with floors and steps
snippets.content:
building: price_calculator
    note: Calculate the final price with discount

    floors:
        floor: calculations
            step: calculate_subtotal
            step: apply_discount

    display "Enter price: "
    set price to input as number
    exit

snippets.name: List
snippets.description: Create, index, and mutate a list
snippets.content:
set numbers to [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
display "First number: " added to (numbers[0] as text)
add "milk" to shopping_list
remove "bread" from shopping_list

snippets.name: Table
snippets.description: Create a table (dictionary) and access/set a value
snippets.content:
set person to ["name": "Alice", "age": 25, "city": "Boston"]
set person["age"] to 26

snippets.name: String Operations
snippets.description: Concatenate and inspect text
snippets.content:
set greeting to "Hello, " added to name added to "!"
set len to length of greeting
set has_world to greeting contains "World"

snippets.name: Attempt/Unsuccessful/Continue
snippets.description: Attempt a risky action, handle failure, then always continue
snippets.content:
attempt:
    set user_input to input as number
    display "You entered: " added to (user_input as text)
if unsuccessful:
    display "Oops! That wasn't a valid number."
    display "The error was: " added to problem_message
    set user_input to 0
then continue:
    display "Moving on with user_input = " added to (user_input as text)

snippets.name: Operators Reference
snippets.description: Worded comparison, boolean, and text operators
snippets.content:
note: Arithmetic: + - * / % (or modulo)
note: Comparison: is equal to / equals / is greater than / is less than or equal to
note: Logical:    and / or / not
note: Text:       added to (concatenation)

snippets.name: Common Built-ins
snippets.description: Frequently used standard library calls
snippets.content:
call round with n storing result in r
call random_int with 1, 100 storing result in rnd
call type of x storing result in t
